business_summary.text: DLF is an Indian real estate developer with over 185 projects and more than 352 million sq ft developed, operating in residential development and commercial/retail leasing (annuity business).

call_points.text: Management reaffirmed revenue inflection starting FY27-FY28 as ~₹75,000 Cr of launched projects begin receiving OCs under completed contract accounting.
call_points.versus_prior: reiterated FY28 revenue inflection from Arbour and subsequent completions

call_points.text: Downtown Chennai Blocks 4 & 5 totaling 3.6 million sq ft are under construction and will become operational by calendar next year.
Downtown Gurgaon Blocks 5, 6, 7, 8 and Mall of India Gurugram target completion between FY28 and FY30.
Upcoming launches include a Mumbai project in Q3 and an unnamed luxury-plus project in DLF Phase 4 in Q4.
Net cash reached ~₹15,100 Cr despite paying a dividend of close to ₹1,980 Cr during Q2.
Q3 construction outflows could face temporary challenges due to festive labor migration and typical 30-40 days of NCR GRAP anti-pollution curbs.
Dahlias sales were about ₹5,000 Cr in FY26 and expected at ₹5,000-6,000 Cr in FY27.
Atrium Place's 3.2 mn sq ft will generate about ₹700 Cr of rent; three malls complete this year.
Downtown Taramani's 3.5 mn sq ft completes in Q2 FY28; 500,000 sq ft already leased.
Dividend of ₹8 per share recommended, up 33% YoY; no dividend guidance given.
FY26 gross margin was 39%, down from 48% in FY25.
call_points.versus_prior: reiterated 39% FY26 gross margin versus 48% in FY25

call_points.text: Goa launch awaits resolution of a PIL; management will not create third-party rights yet.
Large office tenants reviewing internal processes could defer leasing decisions.
FY26 gross margin stood at 39% compared to 48% in FY25.

operating_notes.text: CRISIL upgraded DLF's long-term rating to CRISIL AA+/Stable.
FY26 sales bookings ₹20,143 Cr with embedded gross margins of 37%.
Launch pipeline of ~₹60,215 Cr across ~25 msf remains to be launched.
DCCDL net debt ₹18,150 Cr at 3.2x EBITDA; GAV ₹96,271 Cr.
New sales bookings for FY26 stood at ₹20,143 Cr.
Rental portfolio 50 mn sq ft at 95% occupancy; SEZ vacancy about 10%, Hyderabad 17-20%.
Dahlias sold 32 apartments in Q4FY26 at about ₹90 Cr each; Camellias trades at ₹1,20,000 per sq ft on super area versus Dahlias about ₹1 lakh.
Balance land potential of 137 mn sq ft outside the launch pipeline, mostly in North and metros.
Dahlias is over 60-65% sold with price realisation over ₹1 lakh per sq ft, touching ₹1.2-1.25 lakh on higher floors, and entry prices of ₹100-170 Cr per unit.
Gurgaon office rentals: Atrium Place weighted average ~₹175, Downtown 4 ~₹150-155, Phase 2 leasing averaging ~₹200; Cyber City older buildings ₹140-150 vs ₹210-220 for new, a ~20% like-to-like gap.
Goa mall is ~64% leased as of 31 July with target of 85-90% in 6-8 weeks; the mall is 705,000 sq ft super area with expected rental of ₹170-175 per sq ft.
Rental is reported as a separate consolidated segment: Q2FY27 revenue ₹164.57 Cr and share of JV profit ₹502.43 Cr.
H1FY27 operating cash flow ₹1,953.38 Cr against H1 EBITDA of ₹173.32 Cr.
Q2FY27 operating cash flow was ₹1,858 Cr.
The Aureva luxury retirement project in Gurugram witnessed a complete sell-out in Q2FY27.
Net cash position stood at ₹15,084 Cr despite a ₹1,980 Cr dividend outflow.
Gross margin potential of development business stands at ~₹40,000 Cr with cash generation potential over ₹42,500 Cr.
Consolidating contiguous 36-acre parcel in Sector 61 after completing payments for 7.06 acres and entering 7.48-acre collaboration.
Rental portfolio reached 50 msf with occupancy of 96% by area and 97% by value.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,814.06 Cr (-42.0% YoY), net profit ₹1,268.56 Cr (-1.1% YoY).
2026-05-13: Q4 & FY26 investor presentation — FY26 collections ₹13,517 Cr (+15%), sales bookings ₹20,143 Cr (+25%), net cash ₹14,155 Cr; ₹4,408 Cr dividend proposed.
DLF reported FY26 consolidated net profit of ₹4,256 Cr on revenue of ₹10,174 Cr with sales bookings of ₹20,143 Cr.
2026-05-18: Q4 & FY26 earnings call transcript — FY27 pre-sales guidance held at ₹20,000 Cr, rental NOI guided at mid-teens growth, ₹8 dividend recommended.
Rajiv Singh, Rajdhani Investments & Agencies Private Limited, Kavita Singh, Savitri Devi Singh, and Anushka Singh declared no encumbrance on DLF Limited’s 61.56% shares for FY2026.
Kushal Pal Singh, Promoter, declared no DLF Limited shares held or encumbered as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI Takeover Regulations.
Renuka Talwar’s promoter group, including five entities, declared no encumbrance on DLF’s 6.10% shares held by March 31, 2026.
DLF reported Q2FY27 pre-sales of ₹3,800 Cr and a surge in net cash to ₹15,084 Cr, while net profit grew 11% YoY to ₹1,301 Cr.
DLF submitted applications to stock exchanges for the reclassification of Madhukar Housing and Development Company from promoter to public category.
DLF Limited posted the earnings call recording for Q2FY27 results on its website on October 17, 2026, signed by R. P. Punjani, CFO.
Management held Q2FY27 earnings call outlining ₹75,000 Cr project revenue recognition from FY28 and DCCDL exit rental target of ₹6,800 Cr.
